title: The AI Agent Blueprint: Building Autonomous Workflows Without Code
author: Sumit Singh
target_audience: Solopreneurs, freelancers, and digital creators looking to automate repetitive daily tasks using no-code AI agents
description: A step-by-step tactical guide covering autonomous AI agent architecture, multi-step workflow automation, tool integration, prompt chaining, error handling, and real-world business use cases without writing code.
objective: Equip readers to design, deploy, and scale reliable no-code AI agent workflows that automate lead research, content distribution, and client operations.
